title: A Desolation Called Peace
author: Arkady Martine
summary: As the Teixcalaanli empire faces an unknown alien threat at its border, a diplomat and a cultural liaison struggle to negotiate peace while a ruthless general pushes toward war.
readIf: you like political, language-focused science fiction and have read A Memory Called Empire.
skipIf: you have not read the first book or dislike dense diplomatic plotting.
